intro: In Stormwind City, Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light from the Cathedral of Light. He guides the faithful and the Alliance through uncertain times.

p: Archbishop Benedictus took the Church’s leadership after his mentor, Archbishop Alonsus Faol, died. He had seen the First and Second Wars devastate the kingdoms and helped oversee the building of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. He vowed to uphold the virtues of the faith. After Lordaeron fell and the Scourge rose during the Third War, the human kingdoms looked to him for spiritual guidance. From the Cathedral, he counsels the royal court, trains newly initiated priests, and directs holy crusades against the undead and demonic forces threatening Azeroth.

Across the Alliance, people regard Archbishop Benedictus as a gentle, wise, and benevolent patriarch. He offers the public hope and rallies heroes against dark threats, including Amnennar the Coldbringer in Kalimdor. He also helps purify cursed relics brought by faithful adventurers.
